name: Methamphetamine
warning: High-dose / sleep-deprived presentation. Uses peripheral flicker. Photosensitivity note applies.
tierNotes: Threshold: extra crispness — the over-sharpened vigilant look (early sharpenHalo); snow near-deniable (VSS density is quadratic in weight).
Light: fine visual snow appears on flat surfaces — sparse salt-and-pepper specks shimmering at a fixed ~14 Hz, not per-frame static.

Common: slow granular texture-crawl in FLAT regions only (edges/objects hold still) + first peripheral shadow blobs that emerge from the scene's own dark, high-contrast corners and vanish when the mouse (gaze) approaches.
Strong: frequent image-driven shadow events, harsh contrast, cold desaturation, denser snow.
Heavy: rare humanoid silhouettes (p≈0.025/s, Heavy only) against whichever frame edge is darker; constant crawl; full salt-and-pepper snowstorm.
